params.text:
I was unable to complete the task of drafting a new marketing price rule for fall discount that offers $10 discount on checkout for all customers. The fundamental issue is that the Magento admin login page has username and password fields that are not being detected as interactive elements by the system - only the 'Forgot your password?' link and 'Login' button are interactive. I attempted multiple approaches:

1. Direct login attempts with provided credentials (admin/admin1234) - failed due to non-interactive input fields
2. Password reset requests for admin@example.com and admin@dockerized-magento.local - submitted but no confirmation received
3. Customer login page access - interactive fields exist but admin credentials don't work for customer login
4. Direct URL access to promo_quote/new page - redirected to login
5. Various send_keys and navigation attempts - all failed

The system appears to have a fundamental limitation where the admin login form input fields are not detectable as interactive elements, preventing any login attempts. Without admin access, I cannot navigate to the marketing price rule creation section to draft the requested fall discount rule.

simplified_steps.evaluation: Failed - This is the last step (30/30). I was unable to log into the Magento admin panel due to a fundamental system limitation: the username and password input fields on the admin login page are not being detected as interactive elements by the system. Only the 'Forgot your password?' link (index 0) and 'Login' button (index 1) are interactive. This prevented me from accessing the admin panel to create the marketing price rule.
